primary.title: EPF withdrawal rules: Form 121 replaces Forms 15G and 15H from April 2026
primary.summary: From April 1, 2026, Form 121 replaces Forms 15G and 15H for eligible taxpayers seeking TDS relief on specified income, including qualifying EPF withdrawals. Check who can submit the new declaration, its validity and why it does not automatically make taxable withdrawals tax-free.
